newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Bunge y Born sells chemical unit.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Bunge y Born sells chemical unit.

text.p: Argentine food and industrial conglomerate Bunge y Born said Monday it sold a 45.3-percent stake in agrochemical firm Atanor to U.S. firm DA International for $52.54 million.
The company made the announcement in a letter to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.
Bunge's President Salvador Carbo told Reuters the firm also signed an option to sell its remaining five percent stake in Atanor to Iowa-based DA International, which is part of the Albaugh Inc group.
The deal comes on top of the sale by Molinos Rio de la Plata, Bunge's flagship company, of the whole of its 5.7-percent stake in Atanor for $6.6 million in December.
Atanor, which makes weed-killers and chemical products, posted revenues of $170 million in 1995. It exports about 30 percent of its output.
Atanor was the last of a clutch of companies sold by Bunge as part of a strategy launched three years ago to concentrate on the food business.
"The stance of the group to focus on food is very clear," Carbo said. "In the last year we have been investing in that sector and we will keep investing there."
